description: This file contains unit tests for the TasksViewModel class of an Android application. It includes tests for task loading, adding, updating, completing, deleting, restoring, and retrieving tasks, utilizing a fake DAO implementation for testing purposes.

classes.name: test_TasksViewModel
classes.description: Unit test class for TasksViewModel, testing various functionalities such as task creation, update, deletion, and restoration.

classes.name: FakeTaskDao
classes.description: A fake implementation of TaskDao used in tests to simulate database operations with in-memory storage.

methods.name: initial load seeds welcome tasks when repository is empty
methods.description: Tests that the TasksViewModel fetches initial tasks, including welcome tasks, when the repository is empty.

methods.name: addTask inserts trimmed title and normalizes blank description to null
methods.description: Verifies that adding a task trims the title and sets an empty description to null.

methods.name: updateTask updates title description dueDate and updatedAt
methods.description: Checks that updating a task modifies its properties correctly and updates the timestamp.

methods.name: setCompleted toggles completion and updates updatedAt
methods.description: Ensures toggling task completion status updates the task's 'isCompleted' property and timestamp.

methods.name: deleteTask removes task and restoreTask re-inserts it (undo delete behavior)
methods.description: Tests the delete and restore functionalities, including the ability to undo deletions.

methods.name: getTaskById returns entity when present
methods.description: Verifies that the method retrieves the correct task entity by ID.
